主要内容: Subaru of America, Inc. won the 2015 Best Resale Value Brand Award from Kelley Blue Book. Three models—2015 Impreza, 2015 WRX, and 2015 Legacy—also received Best Resale Value Awards in their categories. The awards are based on projected retained value over five years, using data from the Official Residual Value Guide. Vehicles with MSRP over $60,000 or low-volume models are excluded, except in plug-in, luxury, and high-performance categories. Thomas J. Doll, president and COO of Subaru of America, Inc., noted the awards reflect Subaru's safety, reliability, and durability. Subaru of Indiana Automotive, Inc. is the only U.S. plant designated a backyard wildlife habitat by the National Wildlife Federation, highlighting its environmental commitment.
